description: Alaska's AIRMETs from the Aviation Weather Center's data API (/api/data/airmet, GeoJSON) read into the shape the weather store keeps beside the SIGMETs: [{hazard, type (AIRMET), altitude_low_ft, altitude_high_ft (both null: the API's decoded altitudes misread the text, so each is told at every altitude), raw (hazard and zone), valid_from, valid_to, issued, zone, coords}].
